node_definition.done_when: A CLI worker's dispatch is refused before any worktree, live pointer or run directory exists in two cases: bwrap is absent from PATH, or a user namespace cannot be created. The refusal's error and detail name the missing capability: bwrap not found, or the namespace probe's own failure text. reckon crew dispatch --no-fence REASON launches the same dispatch unfenced. The reason is recorded on the live pointer, in the composed launch plan, and on the run's ledger row at promotion. A run dispatched without the flag records no such field, and a dispatch whose fence composes normally is unchanged. tests/test_the_fence_fails_closed.py drives these cases in a temporary RECKON_HOME with a stub backend. 1: PATH without bwrap is refused naming bwrap, and no worktree, pointer or run directory is left. 2: a namespace probe forced to fail is refused naming the namespace. 3: --no-fence with a reason launches, and the pointer carries the reason. 4: promoting that run writes the reason onto its ledger row. 5: an ordinary fenced dispatch is unchanged. 6: where bwrap can run, a fenced stub's write into a sibling run's worktree fails as a read-only file system while its write into its own worktree lands; where bwrap cannot run, the case skips, and its skip reason names the capability. The declared negative control is executed and logged: in a scratch tree, make the capability check report success when bwrap is absent, and case 1 fails. The test files importing reckon.crew.dispatch or reckon._backends are run at base and at head with pytest-xdist -n 8, each arm with its own --basetemp under /tmp, and they add no failing id. Every log sits under the run directory, headed with revision, tree and literal command, and ends EXIT=, and basetemps are deleted afterwards. Only reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/cli.py, reckon/_backends.py, reckon/crew/promotion.py and the new test file change. If the ledger row needs reckon/ledger.py, the manifest names that change under follow_ons rather than making it.
